title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on the Correct Implementation of the Two "Supplementary Provisions"
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court, Supreme People's Procuratorate

Notice on the Correct Implementation of the Two "Supplementary Provisions"

Gaofa Mingdian (1988) No. 7

To the High People's Courts and People's Procuratorates of various provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, and the Military Court and the Military Procuratorate of the People's Liberation Army:

The "Supplementary Provisions of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress Concerning the Punishment of Smuggling Crimes" and the "Supplementary Provisions of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress Concerning the Punishment of Corruption and Bribery Crimes" were promulgated and took effect on January 21, 1988. In order to correctly implement these two "Supplementary Provisions," notice is hereby given as follows:

1. Cases that occur after the promulgation and implementation of the two "Supplementary Provisions" shall be handled in accordance with the provisions of the two "Supplementary Provisions."

2. Cases that occurred before the promulgation and implementation of the two "Supplementary Provisions" and for which the people's court has already rendered a legally effective judgment or ruling in accordance with the legal provisions in effect at the time shall not be altered.

3. With respect to cases that occurred before the promulgation and implementation of the two "Supplementary Provisions" but have not been processed or are currently being processed after their promulgation and implementation, the issue of how to apply the law shall be handled in accordance with the principle stipulated in Article 9 of the Criminal Law.

January 27, 1988
